headline: Bank of America expands board to 14, appointing James Fitterling and William Thomas
synopsis: Bank of America increased its board from 12 to 14 directors and appointed James Fitterling and William Thomas, effective immediately. Fitterling joined the risk and human-capital committees; Thomas joined the audit and governance committees. Both will receive prorated restricted-stock and cash awards under the existing non-employee director program.

what.text: The board increased its authorized size from 12 to 14 directors, filled both new seats with James Fitterling and William Thomas, and assigned each appointee to two board committees.

where.text: The change is at the parent-company board level and affects the Enterprise Risk, Compensation and Human Capital, Audit, and Corporate Governance committees.
The filing identifies no change to an operating division, customer product, capital ratio, or security terms.

why.text: Bank of America said the appointments add complementary leadership experience to strengthen oversight of long-term strategy. It highlighted Fitterling's complex-industry and public-board experience and Thomas's audit, accounting, and financial-reporting expertise.

how.text: The sitting board created two additional seats and appointed both directors immediately. Each joined two committees and entered the existing non-employee director compensation program, with October 21 awards prorated through the next annual shareholder meeting.

implications.text: The board adds recent large-company operating experience to risk and compensation oversight and audit experience to financial-reporting and governance oversight.
implications.caveat: The filing does not announce a change in strategy, management authority, risk limits, or financial policy.

implications.text: Shareholders now have a 14-member board with two additional directors participating in four oversight committees.
implications.caveat: The filing does not disclose how the appointments will affect future votes or decisions.

evidence.fact: Bank of America Corporation filed an 8-K for an October 21, 2026 event.
The SEC accepted accession 0000070858-26-000494 on October 21, 2026 at 17:07:03 Eastern.
The board increased its size from 12 to 14 and appointed James Fitterling and William Thomas, effective immediately.
Fitterling joined the Enterprise Risk Committee and Compensation and Human Capital Committee; Thomas joined the Audit Committee and Corporate Governance Committee.
Both directors entered the existing non-employee director compensation program and were scheduled to receive prorated restricted-stock and cash awards on October 21.
Fitterling is Dow's executive chair and former CEO; Thomas is KPMG International's former global chair and CEO with audit, accounting, and financial-reporting experience.
The company said the directors' complementary leadership experience would strengthen oversight of long-term strategy.

consolidation.rationale: The board expansion, two appointments, committee assignments, compensation treatment, and incorporated news release describe one governance action.
